title: Earthily Fatty Ukrainian Meat Bake
description: A hearty, fatty Ukrainian dish featuring dried oregano, perfect for satisfying midnight cravings, baked in a tandoor clay pot and gluten-free friendly.

ingredients.name: Ground Pork
ingredients.notes: preferably with a high fat content

instructions: Preheat the tandoor clay pot or a conventional oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground pork, dried oregano, chopped onion, minced garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika, mixing well with your hands until just combined.
Add the lard or tallow to the pork mixture and mix until the meat is cohesive and slightly sticky.
Transfer the meat mixture to the preheated tandoor clay pot or a baking dish.
Arrange the sliced potatoes on top of the meat in a single layer.
Cover the pot or dish with a lid or aluminum foil and bake for 45 minutes.
Remove the lid or foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown and the meat is cooked through.
Remove the pot or dish from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with additional dried oregano if desired.
